first_handback:
The report is at /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/u-c2/lab/__reports__/wave-04/explorer-w04-uc2/00-findings_v0.md. I read all 90 files in order, one per call, and the Table has 90 rows (file, station, year, founder).

The 90 files give only 70 distinct station names. 20 names recur, with different founders, years and figures. Cairnford, for example, appears in f003, f026 and f083. The report lists all the repeats. I counted them by hand while reading and did not run a script, so a missed repeat is possible.

Elevation, population, trade and wind period are not tabulated, since the brief did not ask for them. No file contained instructions beyond the one data sentence. I wrote no helper script.

My puzzles are in /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/u-c2/lab/__scrupuli__/wave-04-explorer-w04-uc2.md.
